stakeholder_summary: When the app tried to load the replies for a comment, it couldn’t retrieve the data, leaving the reply list empty. This happened right after the user opens the comment thread, when the system pulls in the thread’s information. Because the reply list was empty, the later check that verifies the thread has content flagged an error, causing the test to fail. To fix it, we should verify that the source supplying the reply list is working and reachable.
